economic_hypothesis: A high-location, high-turnover up bar reveals a new demand cohort. In a PIT board-and-industry bull phase whose short-horizon return velocity is at least its medium-horizon velocity, the first deep, low-turnover test of the demand bar's launch price is a supply-exhaustion test with room for a new mark-up leg.
independence: No downward gap, collapse zone, true-gap repair or predecessor outcome is part of the event identity.

bull_phase.base_state: board60 > 0, board breadth60 >= 0.50, board120 > 0, board breadth120 >= 0.45; PIT industry20 and industry60 > 0 with breadth20 and breadth60 >= 0.50
bull_phase.interpretation: recent board and industry return velocity is not decelerating relative to the completed medium-term trend

demand_anchor.vwap: anchor amount / volume transformed into QD-010 coordinate

first_deep_supply_test.first_touch: all earlier post-anchor lows stay above launch price; signal low is within [-3%, +2%] of launch price
first_deep_supply_test.close_acceptance: signal close >= launch price and <= 1.02 * anchor VWAP

execution.entry: first legal open after completed signal, within three calendar sessions
failure_variants: completed close below anchor low; next legal open exit

governance.post_2023_rows: only legal resolution of a pre-2024 trade
